headline: Stéphane Brizé Releases New Film Un Bon Petit Soldat In Theaters
seoTitle: Un Bon Petit Soldat Movie Release By Stéphane Brizé
metaDescription: Stéphane Brizé explores corporate workplace pressures in his new film Un Bon Petit Soldat, which arrives in French cinemas on Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
aiSummaryBullets: The film Un Bon Petit Soldat is scheduled for theatrical release in France on November 25, 2026.
Director Stéphane Brizé focuses the narrative on a human resources manager experiencing professional burnout.
The project previously received a screenplay award during the Venice Film Festival.
aiContextParagraph: The film Un Bon Petit Soldat, directed by Stéphane Brizé, centers on the intense pressures within the corporate environment. The story follows a director of human resources navigating extreme professional exhaustion, serving as a continuation of Brizé's established thematic interest in the realities of the labor market, previously seen in works such as La Loi du marché and En guerre. This latest production, which earned recognition for its screenplay at the Mostra de Venise, is part of a broader slate of cinematic releases occurring on November 25, 2026, alongside other films like Congo boy and Paper Tiger. The release reflects the filmmaker's ongoing commitment to examining the psychological and social impacts of workplace management structures, as he explores the intersection of personal health and professional demands in modern industrial or corporate settings.
whyItIsViral: The film has generated strong search interest in France and was covered by a national news outlet as part of the weekly cinema release schedule.
